title: Independence
description: No commercial ties with the contractors or suppliers we evaluate. Our rating is free from any conflict of interest.

title: Confidentiality
description: Your data, results, and rating remain strictly confidential. Anonymized reporting available upon request.

title: Objectivity
description: Structured framework, measurable criteria, reproducible methodology. Every rating is based on facts, not impressions.

title: Progression
description: A rating is not a penalty. It is a starting point. Every organization can progress toward AAA with the right support.
